CodeOfConduct.metaDescription: AmplifiedAccess community standards and code of conduct for contributors and participants.
CodeOfConduct.heroDescription: Our commitment to an open, welcoming, and harassment-free community for everyone.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText1: We as members, contributors, and leaders of the AmplifiedAccess community pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText2: We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and healthy community.
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositiveIntro: Examples of behavior that contribute to a positive environment include:
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive1: Demonstrating empathy and kindness toward other people
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive2: Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive3: Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive4: Accepting responsibility and apologizing to those affected by our mistakes, and learning from the experience
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive5: Focusing on what is best not just for us as individuals, but for the overall community
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative1: The use of sexualized language or imagery, and sexual attention or advances of any kind
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative2: Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative4: Publishing others' private information, such as a physical or email address, without their explicit permission
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative5: Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitiesText1: Community leaders at AmplifiedAccess are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior and will take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any behavior that they deem inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitiesText2: Community leaders have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, wiki edits, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned with this Code of Conduct, and will communicate reasons for moderation decisions when appropriate.
CodeOfConduct.scopeText: This Code of Conduct applies within all community spaces, and also applies when an individual is officially representing the AmplifiedAccess community in public spaces. Examples of representing our community include using an official email address, posting via an official social media account, or acting as an appointed representative at an online or offline event.
CodeOfConduct.reportingIntro: Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the AmplifiedAccess team at:
CodeOfConduct.reportingFollowUp: All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly. All community leaders are obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter of any incident.
CodeOfConduct.guidelinesIntro: Community leaders will follow these guidelines in determining the consequences for any action they deem in violation of this Code of Conduct:
CodeOfConduct.correctionImpactText: Use of inappropriate language or other behavior deemed unprofessional or unwelcome in the community.
CodeOfConduct.correctionConsequenceText: A private, written warning from community leaders, providing clarity around the nature of the violation and an explanation of why the behavior was inappropriate. A public apology may be requested.
CodeOfConduct.warningImpactText: A violation through a single incident or series of actions.
CodeOfConduct.warningConsequenceText: A warning with consequences for continued behavior. No interaction with the people involved, including unsolicited interaction with those enforcing the Code of Conduct, for a specified period of time. Violating these terms may lead to a temporary or permanent ban.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanImpactText: A serious violation of community standards, including sustained inappropriate behavior.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanConsequenceText: A temporary ban from any sort of interaction or public communication with the community for a specified period of time. No public or private interaction with the people involved is allowed during this period. Violating these terms may lead to a permanent ban.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanImpactText: Demonstrating a pattern of violation of community standards, including sustained inappropriate behavior, harassment of an individual, or aggression toward or disparagement of classes of individuals.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanConsequenceText: A permanent ban from any sort of public interaction within the community.
CodeOfConduct.attributionText: This Code of Conduct is adapted from the <covenantLink>Contributor Covenant</covenantLink>, version 2.1, available at <versionLink>contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct</versionLink>.

Security.metaDescription: How to responsibly report security vulnerabilities to the AmplifiedAccess team.
Security.heroDescription: How we handle vulnerability reports and our commitment to responsible disclosure.
Security.intro: AmplifiedAccess takes the security of WatchTower seriously. We appreciate the efforts of security researchers and community members who help us keep the platform safe for everyone.
Security.reportingWarning: Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.
Security.reportingInstruction: Instead, report them directly to our team by emailing:
Security.reportingResponseTime: You should receive a response within 48 hours. If you do not, please follow up via email to confirm we received your original message.
Security.whatToIncludeIntro: To help us triage your report as quickly as possible, please include as much of the following as you can provide:
Security.includeItem1: Type of issue (e.g. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, etc.)
Security.includeItem2: Full paths of the source file(s) related to the manifestation of the issue
Security.includeItem3: The location of the affected code — branch, commit hash, or direct URL
Security.includeItem4: Any special configuration required to reproduce the issue
Security.includeItem5: Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the issue
Security.includeItem6: Proof-of-concept or exploit code, if possible
Security.includeItem7: Impact of the issue, including how an attacker might exploit it
Security.disclosurePolicy: AmplifiedAccess follows the principle of <link>Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure</link>. We ask that you give us a reasonable amount of time to investigate and address a reported issue before any public disclosure.
Security.disclosureFollowUp: We will keep you informed of our progress throughout the investigation and credit you for your discovery if you wish.
Security.languageText: We prefer all security communications to be in English.

About.heroDescription: WatchTower is a community-centered civic intelligence platform that uses AI and local language technologies to enable people to report incidents, risks and rights violations in their own languages and transforms these reports into actionable insights for accountability and response
About.objectiveDescription: To ensure that every person has the power to report civic incidents in the language they speak, so that no voice goes unheard and everybody can participate in holding those responsible to account.
About.languagesDescription: WatchTower currently supports {count} languages enabling more community voices to participate, be heard and contribute to public accountability in the language that feels most natural to them.
About.safetyDescription: We know that speaking up can carry risk. Here is how WatchTower is built to protect you.
About.faqIdentityQuestion: Is my identity protected when I submit a report?
About.faqIdentityAnswer: You never need to provide your name, phone number, or any identifying information to file a report. Anonymous is the default, not the exception.
About.faqAccountQuestion: Do I need to create an account?
About.faqAccountAnswer: There is no profile to create and no login to track. You arrive, you report, you leave. Nothing ties you back to your submission.
About.faqEncryptionQuestion: Can my submission be traced back to me?
About.faqEncryptionAnswer: All submissions are encrypted from the moment you send them. Your report cannot be intercepted or traced back to you in transit.
About.faqVisibilityAnswer: Reports are reviewed only by verified WatchTower administrators. Your submission is never shared publicly with any identifying information attached.
About.faqDeviceQuestion: Can I report from a shared or public device?
About.faqDeviceAnswer: Yes. WatchTower does not store session data or cookies tied to your submission. Reporting from a shared device does not put you at risk.
About.ctaDescription: Submit a civic incident report in your language. No account needed, no personal information required.

Footer.brandDescription: Empowering communities to report civic incidents in their own language, so everyone can participate in civic life and public accountability.

Home.heroDescription: When communities can speak up, things change. Watchtower enables people to report local issues and rights violations in the languages they speak so that everyone can participate in civic life and public accountability.
Home.howItWorksHeading: From a single report <break></break>to system-wide change.
Home.howItWorksDescription: WatchTower is enabling communities to make their voices heard and drive meaningful change.
Home.step1Description: We provide technology to facilitate individuals and communities to report community issues or rights violations directly from their phone or computer in a language they speak.
Home.step2Description: We process and verify every report, mapping incidents and surfacing patterns that would otherwise go unnoticed. Raw information becomes clear, structured intelligence that tells a bigger story.
Home.step3Description: Communities, organizations and institutions access these insights to build cases, hold the right people accountable, and push for meaningful change, backed by real evidence from the ground.
Home.speakNaturallyTitle: Speak naturally. WatchTower helps others understand.
Home.speakNaturallyDescription: Report by voice or text in the language you're most comfortable using. WatchTower helps transcribe, translate and structure reports so information can be understood across languages.
Home.insightsHeading: Ideas, stories and insights from the field.
Home.insightsDescription: Explore perspectives on community reporting, civic participation, multilingual technology and how better information can support meaningful action.
Home.insightsFallback1Title: Why local voices matter in understanding what's happening on the ground
Home.insightsFallback2Title: Breaking the language barrier in civic reporting
Home.insightsFallback3Title: From individual reports to meaningful patterns
Home.faqsDescription: Learn more about reporting, languages, privacy and how WatchTower helps make community information useful.
Home.faq1Answer: WatchTower is a multilingual reporting and civic intelligence tool that enables people to report local issues and rights violations in the languages they speak. Reports can then be organised, mapped and analysed to help reveal patterns and support action.
Home.faq2Question: What can I report on WatchTower?
Home.faq2Answer: You can report incidents such as rights violations, safety concerns and other civic issues happening in your community — anything others should know about or that could help inform action.
Home.faq3Question: Can I report in my own language?
Home.faq3Answer: Yes. You can report by voice or text in the language you're most comfortable using, and WatchTower helps transcribe, translate and structure your report so it can be understood across languages.
Home.faq4Question: Can I submit a report anonymously?
Home.faq4Answer: Yes. Anonymous is the default, not the exception — you never need to provide your name or any identifying information to file a report.
Home.faq5Question: What happens after I submit a report?
Home.faq5Answer: Every report is processed and verified, mapped alongside others to surface patterns, and shared with communities, organizations and institutions who can act on it.
Home.impactDescription: Explore how communities are making their voices heard, shaping decisions and driving action.
Home.ctaDescription: Start reporting incidents with Watchtower, or explore real-time insights on our interactive maps.
Home.missionStatement: WatchTower helps communities report what is happening, understand patterns across reports and turn information from the ground into intelligence that can support action.
Home.exploreDescription: Explore reports across places, issues, languages and time to understand what's happening on the ground.
